t: 25W glue gun suitable for use with all 11mm diameter universal glue sticks. Features 5 minute heat-up time and anti-drip nozzle, which releases glue smoothly with no drips and is easy to control for precision application. Thermal-insulated, heat-resistant rubber cap helps prevent burns and safety fuse provides overheat protection. Ideal for bonding various materials together. Supplied with 12 x 11mm glue sticks and fold-up stand to keep gun steady when not in use.
